arguments.title: Wind Farm Maintenance Plan - Synthetic Farm Report
arguments.markdown:
# Wind Farm Maintenance Plan

**Note on synthetic grouping:** This farm is synthetic (an invented grouping of real photos); years 2017/2018 are part of that grouping and synthetic labels for comparison. Trends reflect differences in counts/verified severities between these synthetic inspections, not necessarily real temporal degradation of a single physical blade.

## 1. Deterministic Priority Ranking (from `list_turbines`)

Ranking is used as returned — not re-ranked — based on deterministic priority score of verified defects.

| Rank | Turbine | Priority Score | Status | Trend vs Previous Synthetic Inspection | Reason (tool) | Inspections |
|------|---------|---------------|--------|----------------------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| 1 | T02 | 9.0 | needs_review | worse | max verified severity 3; 5 defects; 3 need review; trend worse vs the previous inspection | T02-2017, T02-2018 |
| 2 | T01 | 5.75 | needs_review | same | max verified severity 3; 8 defects; 7 need review; trend same vs the previous inspection | T01-2017, T01-2018 |
| 3 | T06 | 2.5 | needs_review | worse | no verified defect; 3 defects; 3 need review; trend worse vs the previous inspection | T06-2017, T06-2018 |
| 4 | T10 | 1.25 | needs_review | worse | no verified defect; 6 defects; 5 need review; 1 need new photos; trend worse vs the previous inspection | T10-2017, T10-2018 |
| 5 | T07 | 1.0 | needs_review | better | max verified severity 1; 5 defects; 4 need review; trend better vs the previous inspection | T07-2017, T07-2018 |
| 6 | T08 | 0.25 | needs_review | better | no verified defect; 4 defects; 2 need review; 2 need new photos; trend better vs the previous inspection | T08-2017, T08-2018 |

Ranks 7-12 (not processed in detail per 6-turbine limit): T03, T04, T05, T09, T11, T12.

**Explanation:** Priority score aggregates verified (verdict ok) severities. Only T02 and T01 have verified severity 3 defects in latest inspection driving highest scores. Trend compares verified severities and counts between 2017 and 2018 synthetic inspections via `compare_inspections`.

## 2. Inspection Summary & Trend Analysis (Top 6)

**T02:** T02-2017: 5 defects, max severity 1 (verified: [1]) | T02-2018: 5 defects, max severity 3, 3 need review (verified: [3,3]) — **worse**. Verified defects increased severity.
**T01:** T01-2017: 4 defects, max severity 3, 1 needs_review, 1 reinspect (verified: [3,3]) | T01-2018: 8 defects, max severity 3, 7 need review (verified: [3]) — **same** max severity, higher count of unverified defects.
**T06:** T06-2017: 2 defects, no verified | T06-2018: 3 defects, no verified — **worse** (defect count rise, no verified severity to act on).
**T10:** T10-2017: 2 defects, no verified, 2 reinspect | T10-2018: 6 defects, no verified, 5 needs_review, 1 reinspect — **worse** count increase, no verified severity.
**T07:** T07-2017: 4 defects, max 3 (verified: [3,1,1]) | T07-2018: 5 defects, max 1, 4 need review (verified: [1]) — **better** (max verified severity down from 3 to 1).
**T08:** T08-2017: 9 defects, max 3 (verified: [3,3,3,3]) | T08-2018: 4 defects, no verified, 2 needs_review, 2 reinspect (verified: []) — **better** (no verified in latest).

## 3. Work Orders — Repair (Verified verdict ok only)

Severity mapping: 4-5 → P1 repair, 3 → P2 repair, 2 → P3 monitor, 1 → no order.

### WO-001 — T02-2018 — P2 Repair
- **Defects:** T02-2018/DJI_0711_01_04/d1 (surface_damage, severity 3, confidence 0.38, agreement 1.0), T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d1 (surface_damage, severity 3, confidence 0.58, agreement 1.0)
- **Action:** Schedule rope-access repair for surface damage (severity 3) on two blade locations
- **Rationale:** Both defects verified ok with severity 3, agreement 1.0, rule checks passed; trend worse vs 2017 (max verified severity rose from 1 to 3)
- **Due:** 30 days

### WO-002 — T01-2018 — P2 Repair
- **Defect:** T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d2 (crack, severity 3, confidence 0.52, agreement 1.0)
- **Action:** Schedule crack repair for verified severity 3 defect on blade
- **Rationale:** Defect verified ok severity 3 with agreement 1.0 and all rule checks passed; T01 ranked #2 by deterministic priority score
- **Due:** 30 days

No other P1/P2/P3 orders created: T06, T10, T08 have no verified defects in 2018; T07 has one verified defect T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d6 with severity 1 (dirt, confidence 0.42, verdict ok) which per policy (severity 1 needs no order) does not generate a work order.

## 4. Re-inspection Requests (Unverified defects — verdict needs_review / reinspect)

Created because low confidence / disagreement means asking for better evidence, never guessing severity.

- **WO-003 — T02-2018:** T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d2, T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d5, T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d6 — Reason: verdict needs_review: low confidence / disagreement between looks
